## Chapter 5B Routing Decisions **RULER:** Andrés Manuel López Obrador (AMLO) **PERIOD:** 2018–2024 (presidential term) **SOURCE:** BOOK-013 — CIDOB political biography **ROUTING STANDARD:** High-recall calibration; include any chunk containing at least one concrete named policy action, measured outcome, cost, distributional result, implementation finding, method/qualification, attribution fact, or contrary finding. --- ### U0061 — EXCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0061 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 61 | | **relevance** | None | | **applicable_lenses** | — | | **adjacent_context_identified** | U0061 contains campaign-registration date, polling numbers (30%), and discourse framing the "Fourth Transformation" as peaceful and reconciliatory. The stated goals of "honest government," "ending corruption and impunity," and "no retaliation" are **rhetorical commitments** — not policy actions, measured outcomes, costs, or implementation details. | | **exclusion_reason** | Generic political-marketing discourse and candidate positioning. No concrete policy action, quantified commitment, institutional mechanism, cost figure, or measured outcome. The anti-corruption framing is aspirational narrative absent any specific rule, enforcement action, or institutional reform. | --- ### U0062 — INCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0062 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 62 | | **relevance** | High — contains multiple specific quantified commitments and concrete policy proposals | | **applicable_lenses** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.8 | | **concrete_evidence_records** | • **"Austeridad republicana"**: fiscal adjustment via state-current-spending savings + reorientation to investment, without tax increases, without new debt — concrete fiscal-rule commitment.
• **Minimum wage increase to 171 pesos** by end of sexenio — specific distributional target.
• **Old-age pensions of 1,500 pesos/month** — specific distributional commitment.
• **Border-state tax reductions** — specific tax-policy measure with regional incidence.
• **Increase domestic gasoline production** to reduce imports and lower prices — specific economic policy action with trade/implementational dimension.
• **Energy self-sufficiency** goal + review/reversal of Peña Nieto energy reform — specific policy reversal with legislative/economic significance.
• **Agricultural price guarantees** for domestic producers — specific distributional/industrial policy. | | **adjacent_context_identified** | Electoral program period (campaign, pre-presidency); the quantified commitments later became governing policy targets. Electoral program is the formal antecedent of the executed agenda — relevant as "stated agenda" under 5B.1 but electoral-period framing should be noted during judging. | --- ### U0063 — PARTIALLY INCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0063 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 63 | | **relevance** | Mixed — material economic governance content interleaved with rhetorical framing | | **applicable_lenses** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.6, 5B.9 | | **concrete_evidence_records** | • **Three-year pacification goal** via new National Guard ("meta de pacificar México en tres años") — specific implementation timeline with security/economic nexus.
• **Social-causes principle**: poverty reduction and human development for vulnerable groups — policy method/qualification.
• **Gradual military withdrawal** from internal security pending National Guard deployment — conditional implementation method.
• **Anti-corruption by institutional example** from Los Pinos — policy orientation claim.
• **Macroeconomic orthodoxy commitments**: free market, free trade, budgetary discipline, peso float, Banxico autonomy — specific institutional rule commitments under 5B.3.
• **Rejection of neoliberalism, privatization, foreign control of strategic sectors** — directional policy stance with economic governance implications.
• **"No voy a meter a Peña Nieto en la cárcel"** — **contrary finding**: a concrete statement contradicting the stated anti-corruption enforcement principle; specific attribution fact with 5B.5 implications. | | **adjacent_context_identified** | The label "pragmatic social democracy" and "ni chavismo, ni trumpismo" are ideological framing — excluded as rhetorical. The migrant defense rhetoric is political/diplomatic context — excluded. The "discovering the causes of violence" passage frames the security approach — relevant adjacent context for 5B.9 but not independently scored. | | **exclusion_reason_for_substring** | "Plataforma lopezobradorista… sugería una socialdemocracia pragmática que ni comulgaba con…" — rhetorical genre-labeling; no concrete policy content. | --- ### U0064 — PARTIALLY INCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0064 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 64 | | **relevance** | Mixed — specific policy decisions interleaved with generic proposal descriptions | | **applicable_lenses** | 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.8 | | **concrete_evidence_records** | • **Santa Lucía Airport (AISL) vs. NAIM**: concrete policy reversal citing specific rationale — "sobrecostes exorbitantres y su impacto medioambiental" — a cost and environmental finding driving a major infrastructure decision.
• **Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro**: youth scholarship/becas program — specific distributional program with economic capacity-building dimension. | | **adjacent_context_identified** | "Internet libre y gratuito en todo el territorio nacional" — policy proposal too vague to constitute an evidence record (no target, cost, timeline, or implementation method). "Cerrar las brechas de desigualdad… sobre todo en el ámbito laboral, entre hombres y mujeres" — distributional goal but lacks implementation specificity. "Creación de los mecanismos legales de la revocación de mandatos y desafuero" — institutional mechanism mentioned without detail; adjacent context only. Campaign closure event (87,000-seat stadium) is political context, not economic governance evidence. | | **exclusion_reason_for_substrings** | Universal internet: no specificity, no cost, no implementation method. Inequality/gender gap language: aspirational without concrete policy instrument or quantified target. Revocación/desafuero: named but undeveloped. | --- ### U0065 — INCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0065 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 65 | | **relevance** | High — contains concrete enforcement commitments and distributional principles | | **applicable_lenses** | 5B.1, 5B.5, 5B.7, 5B.8 | | **concrete_evidence_records** | • **Anti-corruption enforcement universality**: "bajo ninguna circunstancia el próximo presidente permitirá la corrupción ni la impunidad… sea quien sea, será castigado, incluyo a compañeros de lucha, funcionarios, amigos y familiares" — concrete enforcement commitment with specific scope extension to politically connected actors.
• **"Por el bien de todos, primero los pobres"** — explicit distributional prioritization principle.
• **"No mentir, no robar, no traicionar"** — specific stated integrity framework (anti-corruption rule).
• **"Transición con armonía, de manera ordenada, pacífica"** — implementation process commitment. | | **adjacent_context_identified** | Electoral victory margin (53.19%) and turnout (64.4%) provide mandate scale but no direct economic governance evidence. Acknowledged as background. | --- ### U0066 — EXCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0066 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 66 | | **relevance** | None — structural/electoral results; no economic governance content | | **applicable_lenses** | — | | **adjacent_context_identified** | Congressional majority (308/500 lower chamber, 69/128 Senate) provides political feasibility context for agenda implementation — acknowledged as necessary adjacent context but not independently meeting the evidence test. MORENA gubernatorial wins are political, not economic governance evidence. | | **exclusion_reason** | Electoral and legislative outcome data. No policy action, cost, measured outcome, or distributional finding. The majority context is noted as adjacent context but is structural/political, not economic governance evidence per 5B. | --- ### U0067 — EXCLUDED | Field | Value | |---|---| | **chunk_id** | U0067 | | **locator** | extracted HTML block 67 | | **relevance** | None | | **applicable_lenses** | — | | **adjacent_context_identified** | None — publisher institutional boilerplate (footer, copyright, navigation links). | | **exclusion_reason** | Publisher infrastructure text. No content relating to the ruler, policies, budgets, or economic governance. | --- ## Coverage Summary | 5B Lens | U0062 | U0063 | U0064 | U0065 | Notable Gaps | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 5B.1 — Prosperity agenda | ✓ Specific targets | ✓ Framework | Partial | ✓ Enforcement principle | Campaign-period framing caveat | | 5B.2 — Qualified professionals | — | — | — | — | **No evidence in this source** | | 5B.3 — Credible fiscal/monetary rules | ✓ Austerity, no debt | ✓ Market orthodoxy, Banxico | — | — | | | 5B.4 — Fair competition/regulatory | ✓ Energy reform reversal | ✓ Self-sufficiency | Partial | — | | | 5B.5 — Anti-corruption enforcement | — | **Contrary finding** (no jail for Peña Nieto) | — | ✓ Universal accountability | | | 5B.6 — Budget outputs | Partial (wage/pension targets) | ✓ Security timeline | ✓ Airport cost finding | — | Evidence of delivery vs. targets | | 5B.7 — Reliable info/audit | — | — | — | Partial | **No evidence in this source** | | 5B.8 — Fair distribution | ✓ Wage/pension/regional tax | — | Partial | ✓ "Primero los pobres" | Tax incidence not covered | | 5B.9 — Shock response | — | ✓ Social-causes/security approach | — | — | Inflation/debt shock specifics absent | | 5B.10 — Trajectory | Partial | ✓ Framework continuity + reversal | Partial | — | Need pre/post GDP/institutional comparison |
